caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. The chair has four straight legs, a square seat, a flat backrest with four vertical slats evenly spaced between a top and bottom horizontal support, and crossbars connecting the legs near the bottom for added stability. The wood is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with visible grain and texture, and the seat appears slightly lighter in color than the rest of the chair. The chair is viewed at an angle, showing the front and right side, and the drawing is detailed, emphasizing the natural wear and variations in the wood. There are no additional decorative elements or features in the background, which is uniformly colored.
title: Wooden Straight Chair
